REJECTION_SAMPLING_METRIC_MISNAMED: rejection_sampling_never_exhausted is derived from zeroWinnerCheckFailures, not an exhaustion counter. An actual exhaustion throws before the field is produced, so the field cannot independently establish its own claim.

failure_codes.finding: A month-only mapping wins every generated session: June/July→つぶたね, August→まんまる, September→ことね. Deadline and heat never change the required selection.
The claimed three-condition comparison collapses to one month lookup because a canonical winner exists for every month across all accepted deadline/forecast combinations.

The four-entry month mapping is a content-independent memorization strategy with 100% success, which the supplied season_only_heuristic fails to test because it randomly chooses among seasonally eligible varieties.
The exact 90/125/135-day and heat-tolerance attributes drive scoring despite being explicitly unverified; internal disclosure does not prevent children from receiving them as factual varietal data.
Five required current-version artifacts do not exist, preventing independent verification of the current upstream design chain.
The requested run did not complete successfully, and generated_at makes exact byte-for-byte reproduction impossible even in a writable environment.
A flat failure followed by immediate session termination provides no actionable learning loop or in-session reconsideration.
September has a 1/6 acceptance probability per draw, so 200 consecutive rejection failures remain theoretically possible and cause a thrown error.

recommended_actions: Redesign the payoff matrix and test every deterministic month-only policy. At least one month must have two accepted session states requiring different varieties because of deadline or heat—not merely allowing an extra co-winner.

Add an exhaustive enumerator over all month×offset×forecast states and report the complete winner set for each accepted state. Include optimal policies using month only, month+deadline, and month+forecast.
Generate sessions directly from precomputed valid tuples or provide a deterministic fallback so exhaustion is impossible; separately count resampling attempts and maximum attempts observed.
Remove or source the exact varietal values, or clearly label the cards themselves as fictional practice data without implying a direct numeric correspondence to the Fukui trial.
Restore and submit the five missing current-version artifacts, with source-artifact references aligned to v3/v4.
Make simulation output reproducible by separating volatile metadata from the deterministic result or accepting a fixed timestamp/seed, then compare deterministic content byte-for-byte.
Provide one in-session retry with non-answer-revealing feedback that directs the child to reconsider deadline, sowing window, or heat compatibility.
Make per-session card shuffling a mandatory translation/spec invariant with a regression test rather than a deferred note.
